result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: one layout problem where the bottom navigation overlaps page content, and one minor text typo in the search placeholder.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the restaurant card content, leaving the lower part of the list item hidden/cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are fully visible above the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The search placeholder says "Restarants, dishes, groceries" instead of "Restaurants, dishes, groceries".
issues.suggestion: Fix the spelling in the placeholder text to improve polish and readability.
